knowledge:
- key_parameters: conditional=Logical (TRUE/FALSE) indicating whether to perform conditional testing using the category hierarchy to reduce redundant significant parent categories ;; testDirection=Character string specifying the direction of the test, such as "over" for hypergeometric over-representation, or "up"/"down" for linear model-based GSEA ;; universeGeneIds=Vector of gene identifiers representing the background gene universe ;; geneIds=Vector of selected gene identifiers of interest (used in hypergeometric tests) ;; geneStats=Named vector of gene-level statistics, such as t-statistics (used in linear model tests) ;; annotation=Character string specifying the metadata annotation package (e.g., "hgu95av2") ;; pvalueCutoff=Numeric value specifying the significance threshold for testing ;; minSize=Integer specifying the minimum category size to be included in the analysis
- alternatives: limma=Used for computing per-gene t-statistics prior to category testing ;; GOstats=Mentioned as a related package for testing GO term associations ;; cb_contingency=Mentioned as an alternative local test using contingency tables for chromosome bands
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing coordinated gene expression changes across predefined categories (pathways, chromosome bands, GO terms) rather than focusing solely on individual differentially expressed genes, especially when categories have a nested or hierarchical structure.
- pitfalls: Confounding factors (such as sex/gender) can bias category analysis if a category contains sex-linked genes (e.g., RPS4Y1 in the Ribosome pathway); users should adjust for covariates using per-gene linear models before GSEA. Duplicate mappings to Entrez IDs must be filtered out to avoid distorting the gene universe. There is a trade-off between bottom-up testing (higher absolute false positives) and top-down testing (potential loss of power due to Simpson's paradox).

workflows.name: pathway_category_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform pathway-based category analysis using t-statistics, permutation testing, and custom category functions.
input: esetA.RData (ExpressionSet containing microarray expression data and phenotype metadata)
workflows.stages: 1. Filter and preprocess the ExpressionSet to remove duplicate Entrez ID mappings ;; 2. Compute per-gene t-statistics using rowttests ;; 3. Map genes to pathways and build the category incidence matrix ;; 4. Compute observed category-level statistics ;; 5. Generate a permutation distribution using ttperm to calculate empirical p-values ;; 6. Apply custom functions across categories using applyByCategory
workflows.code:
ttests = rowttests(esetASub, "mol.biol")
fL = findLargest(featureNames(esetASub), abs(ttests$statistic), "hgu95av2")
fL2 = probes2Path(fL, "hgu95av2")
inBoth = fL %in% names(fL2)
fL = fL[inBoth]
eS = esetASub[match(names(fL2), featureNames(esetASub)),]
tobs = rowttests(eS, "mol.biol")
Amat = t(PWAmat("hgu95av2"))
AmER = Amat[,names(fL)]
rs = rowSums(AmER)
AmER2 = AmER[rs>5,]
rs2   = rs[rs>5]
nCats = length(rs2)
tA = AmER2 %*% tobs$statistic
tA = tA/sqrt(rs2)
names(tA) = row.names(AmER2)
v1 = ttperm(exprs(eS), eS$mol.biol, B=NPERM)
permDm <- matrix(0.0, nrow=length(v1$perms[[1]]$statistic),
                 ncol=length(v1$perms))
for (j in 1:ncol(permDm)) {
    permDm[ , j] <- v1$perms[[j]]$statistic
}
permD = AmER2 %*% permDm
permD2 = sweep(permD, 1, sqrt(rs2), "/")
pvals = matrix(NA, nr=nCats, ncol=2)
dimnames(pvals) = list(row.names(AmER2), c("Lower", "Upper"))
for(i in 1:nCats) {
    pvals[i,1] = sum(permD2[i,] < tA[i])/NPERM
    pvals[i,2] = sum(permD2[i,] > tA[i])/NPERM
}
med = applyByCategory(tobs$statistic, AmER2, FUN=median)
wt  = applyByCategory(tobs$statistic, AmER2, 
  FUN = function(x) with(wilcox.test(x), c(statistic, p=p.value)))

workflows.name: chrom_band_hypergeometric_test
workflows.intent: Perform standard and conditional hypergeometric testing for over-representation of chromosome bands in a list of selected genes.
input: bcrAblOrNeg.RData (ExpressionSet containing microarray expression data and phenotype metadata)
workflows.stages: 1. Filter the ExpressionSet and define the gene universe and selected gene list ;; 2. Create a ChrMapHyperGParams parameter object ;; 3. Run the hypergeometric test using hyperGTest ;; 4. Summarize results using summary
workflows.code:
filterAns <- nsFilter(bcrAblOrNeg,
                      require.entrez = TRUE, 
                      remove.dupEntrez = TRUE, 
                      var.func = IQR, var.cutoff = 0.5)
nsFiltered <- filterAns$eset
hasSYM <- sapply(mget(featureNames(nsFiltered), symbolMap, ifnotfound=NA),
                 function(x) length(x) > 0 && !is.na(x[1]))
hasMAP <- sapply(mget(featureNames(nsFiltered), bandMap, ifnotfound=NA),
                 function(x) length(x) > 0 && !is.na(x[1]))
nsFiltered <- nsFiltered[hasSYM & hasMAP, ]
affyUniverse <- featureNames(nsFiltered)
entrezUniverse <- unlist(mget(affyUniverse, entrezMap))
names(affyUniverse) <- entrezUniverse
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + nsFiltered$mol.biol)
colnames(design) <- c("BCR/ABL", "NEG")
contr <- c(1, -1)
fm1 <- lmFit(nsFiltered, design)
fm2 <- contrasts.fit(fm1, contr)
fm3 <- eBayes(fm2)
ttestLimma <- topTable(fm3, number = nrow(fm3), adjust.method = "none")
ttestLimma <- ttestLimma[featureNames(nsFiltered), ]
ttestCutoff <- 0.01
smPV  <- ttestLimma$P.Value < ttestCutoff
pvalFiltered <- nsFiltered[smPV, ]
selectedEntrezIds <- unlist(mget(featureNames(pvalFiltered), entrezMap))
params <- new("ChrMapHyperGParams",
              conditional=FALSE,
              testDirection="over",
              universeGeneIds=entrezUniverse,
              geneIds=selectedEntrezIds,
              annotation="hgu95av2",
              pvalueCutoff=0.05)
paramsCond <- params
paramsCond@conditional <- TRUE
hgans <- hyperGTest(params)
hgansCond <- hyperGTest(paramsCond)
sumUn <- summary(hgans, categorySize=1)
sumCond <- summary(hgansCond, categorySize=1)

workflows.name: chrom_band_linear_model_gsea
workflows.intent: Perform linear model-based GSEA to test for association between gene-level statistics and chromosome band membership, supporting conditional testing.
input: bcrAblOrNeg.RData (ExpressionSet containing microarray expression data and phenotype metadata)
workflows.stages: 1. Compute per-gene statistics (t-statistics) ;; 2. Create a ChrMapLinearMParams parameter object ;; 3. Build the chromosome band graph and gene set collection ;; 4. Run the linear model category test using linearMTest ;; 5. Summarize results
workflows.code:
params <- new("ChrMapLinearMParams",
              conditional = FALSE,
              testDirection = "up",
              universeGeneIds = entrezUniverse,
              geneStats = tstats,
              annotation = "hgu95av2",
              pvalueCutoff = 0.01, 
              minSize = 4L)
params@graph <- makeChrBandGraph(params@annotation, params@universeGeneIds)
params@gsc <- makeChrBandGSC(params@graph)
paramsCond <- params
paramsCond@conditional <- TRUE
lmans <- linearMTest(params)
lmansCond <- linearMTest(paramsCond)
